main_text.p: quidem Christianos, præcipuè autem ad Eccle-siæ ministros spectant.
main_text.head: HVIVS SECVNDÆ PAR-tis Synopsis:
main_text.l: Propriam cuiusque conscientiam, ut quisque exhibitam sibi Dei gratiam magni æstimet, & à peccatis, præsertim idololatrarum commercio caveat: cap. 6.
Fideles verbi ministros, qui debita gratitudine recipiendi, vbi simul de fructibus conuersionis disserit. c.7.
Pseudapostolos tam facile reciperent, tantique facerent, se verè contenderent; Purgat igitur se itemrum, excusans suam
Variis sese peccatis polluerent: cap.13. usque ad v.11. vbi est Conclusio.
main_text.p: Capitis v 1. partes principales duæ sunt: In priore pergit declarare rationem sui ministerij, &c.

page.notes: The synopsis is a brace diagram; levels were read from the braces. The page number at top right is blurred and uncertain. "cap:II." and "Capitis v 1." are read as printed but are not fully clear. The word "itemrum" in the Pseudapostolos box is as printed and may be a printing error. The vertical label at far left, "Corinthios prima", is partly unclear.
